purpose: DISCOVERY CANDIDATES ONLY. Not approved training data until verified + license-audited. This group supplies WSTU's state->action / preference ordering targets.

candidates.name: Anthropic HH-RLHF
candidates.notes: Human preference comparisons (chosen vs rejected) for helpfulness and harmlessness. Preferred-action target: chosen response.

candidates.name: HelpSteer
candidates.notes: Human ratings on helpfulness/correctness/coherence/complexity/verbosity (0-4). Numeric label targets => WSTU numeric/scalar output.

candidates.name: HelpSteer2
candidates.notes: ~10k high-quality human preference + attribute ratings pairs.

candidates.name: HelpSteer3
candidates.notes: Multilingual preference data (code + general domains). Bridges decision data with non-English coverage.

candidates.name: UltraFeedback Binarized
candidates.notes: Human-annotated preference annotations over model-generated responses (curated by UltraFeedback pipeline). data_origin=synthetic_responses + human_labels; must be tagged.

candidates.name: UltraFeedback (raw)
candidates.notes: 64k prompts with 4 model responses each + GPT-4 ratings across 4 aspects. Synthetic responses with model-based labels.

candidates.name: Summarize from Feedback
candidates.notes: Human comparisons of TL;DR summaries + axis scores. Preference target = chosen summary.

candidates.name: Tulu preference datasets
candidates.notes: Mixture of aligned preference datasets used to train Tulu. Aggregator: contains synthetic and human subsets; provenance must be split per source.

candidates.name: xLAM Function Calling 60k
candidates.notes: 60k query + tool-spec -> call arguments. STRONG WSTU decision format: context + available actions -> selected action + arguments.

candidates.name: GAIA benchmark
candidates.notes: 466 real-world assistant tasks requiring tool use and multi-step reasoning. evaluation_only benchmark; answers are hidden for test.

candidates.name: Summarize-from-feedback (TLDR filter)
candidates.notes: Community cleaning of OpenAI's TLDR preferences. Duplicate risk vs openai/summarize_from_feedback.
